notes: All products are ILLUSTRATIVE summaries of public information for a demo. They are not offers, quotes or advice. The agent must never apply on the owner's behalf.
amount_* and tenor_* are null when no public figure was found. Rates are text because most sources give ranges or conditions.
documents_required lists are typical practice for this product type and are NOT taken from the cited source unless stated.
Each product has an 'unconfirmed' list naming facts that could not be verified from a primary or official source.
Eligibility rules use the field dictionary below. A rule with confirmed=false is an assumption and should be shown to the owner as such.

field_dictionary.years_trading: Years since the business started trading (number)
field_dictionary.annual_revenue_local: Trailing 12-month revenue in the product's currency (number)
field_dictionary.sector: Sector code from the SME profile (string)
field_dictionary.country_registered: ISO country where the business is registered (string)
field_dictionary.cib_clear: Not classified as a defaulter in the credit bureau (boolean; Bangladesh CIB)
field_dictionary.tax_credit_grade: Tax credit grade, China: A, B, M, C or D (string)
field_dictionary.dscr: Debt service cover ratio computed by the engine from the forecast (number)
field_dictionary.months_card_sales: Months of card or POS sales history available (number)
field_dictionary.b2b_invoice_share: Share of revenue invoiced on credit to businesses, 0 to 1 (number)
field_dictionary.owner_age: Age of the owner or legal representative (number)
field_dictionary.tax_arrears: Business has an unpaid tax bill it cannot pay in full (boolean)
field_dictionary.insolvent: Business is insolvent or in formal difficulty (boolean)
field_dictionary.has_bkash_ekyc: Owner has a wallet account with full biometric eKYC (boolean; Bangladesh)

products.name: Bangladesh Bank CMSME Working Capital Refinance Fund (Tk 5,000 crore, revolving)
products.provider: Bangladesh Bank refinance to participating scheduled banks; the bank lends
products.indicative_rate_text: Banks may charge borrowers at most 9% a year (Bangladesh Bank lends to the bank at 4%). Interest calculated quarterly. Grace period 3 to 6 months before instalments start. Scheme runs for 3 years from issue (announced 8 June 2026).
products.collateral: Set by the lending bank; the bank bears recovery risk
documents_required: Existing working-capital loan renewal letter, if any
unconfirmed: Per-borrower loan limit and tenor not in the article; check the Bangladesh Bank SME and Special Programmes Department circular
Issue date differs between sources (8 June vs possibly 8 August 2026)
Banks sign participation agreements one by one; the owner's own bank may not participate yet

products.name: Bank unsecured CMSME loan (collateral-free)
products.provider: Commercial bank with a collateral-free SME programme (example: BRAC Bank)
products.indicative_rate_text: A promotional rate as low as 13.75% a year was reported for August and September 2025 and has probably expired. Without that offer, market rates are higher; the all-bank weighted average lending rate was 11.86% in June 2026 (secured and corporate loans included).
unconfirmed: Amount range is from a TBS article (Tk 1 to 25 lakh) and an older thesis (Tk 3 to 30 lakh); they disagree
Tenor not found
One-year trading minimum comes from an old thesis
Promotional rate expired

products.name: Secured working-capital overdraft / cash credit (against FDR or property)
products.indicative_rate_text: Not confirmed for a specific product. Context: all-bank weighted average lending rate 11.86% and NBFI 13.75% in June 2026 (Bangladesh Bank data as reported); banks price off the SMART reference rate plus a margin.
products.collateral: Fixed deposit receipt, property or other security
unconfirmed: No specific product page read; limits, tenor and fees are generic assumptions
Annual 12-month tenor assumed (usual review cycle)
Only the lending-rate context is sourced

products.name: Microfinance institution (MFI) micro-enterprise loan
products.provider: MRA-licensed microfinance institutions (for example BRAC, ASA, Grameen)
products.indicative_rate_text: Rate cap of 24% a year on a declining balance (lowered from 27% to 24% in 2019, per secondary sources). The effective cost is often higher in practice.
unconfirmed: Current MRA cap was not read from the MRA itself
Loan size limits not found
Tenor not found
Not suited to a business with Tk 36 million turnover; included to show a low-fit match

products.name: Digital nano loan through a wallet app (City Bank and bKash)
products.provider: City Bank PLC via bKash app
products.indicative_rate_text: 9% a year plus a processing fee of about 0.5% (0.575% including VAT in one report). A related Pay Later product is interest-free if repaid in 7 days.
unconfirmed: Tk 50,000 limit is from one June 2025 Daily Star report; earlier reports say Tk 20,000
Tenor sources differ
A personal consumer-style product; suitable only for tiny cash gaps

products.name: WeBank Weiyedai (微业贷) online unsecured working-capital loan
products.provider: WeBank (also offered as a co-lending version with Standard Chartered)
products.indicative_rate_text: Shown at signing; no fee beyond interest if no breach (per the Standard Chartered co-lending page). App-store pages cited a rate range of 2.88% to 18% a year; this is old and conflicting.
products.collateral: None; guarantee by the legal representative
documents_required: Authorisation for tax and bank data (typical)
Proof of fund use after drawdown: contracts, payment vouchers or bank statements
unconfirmed: RMB 3 million cap is for the co-lending version; WeBank's own ceiling was reported elsewhere as 10 million (enterprise) and as 3 million; no official page read
Rate and tenor not stated
Launch year 2017 and 1.7 million enterprises granted credit by June 2025 are from a trade-press report (https://news.pedaily.cn/20260112/121928.shtml); that page did not state amounts or rates
A cross-border e-commerce company with mostly overseas revenue may not meet WeBank's data-driven scoring; not confirmed

products.name: Bank-tax interaction credit loan (银税互动, e.g. 税易贷)
products.provider: Commercial banks working with the tax authority
products.indicative_rate_text: Not given. Reported as generally lower than other commercial unsecured loans; varies by bank and region.
products.collateral: None (pure credit loan based on tax credit grade and tax data)
documents_required: Online authorisation for tax credit and tax data
unconfirmed: Grade scope (A, B, M) is from older reporting; some regions widened it to grade C during the pandemic
Local rules differ
No amounts or rates
Current national rules not read from the State Taxation Administration

products.name: Inclusive small and micro enterprise loan (普惠型小微企业贷款)
products.indicative_rate_text: People's Bank of China data: weighted average rate on new inclusive small-micro loans 3.48% in June 2025 (a market average, not an offer; actual price depends on the borrower).
products.collateral: Varies by bank (mortgage, guarantee or credit)
unconfirmed: Single-borrower credit of 10 million yuan or less is the statistical definition, not a product limit
The 3.48% figure came from a search-result summary; the linked Xinhua article was not opened individually
Revenue ceiling for small enterprises is an assumption

products.name: Government-backed financing guarantee for a bank loan (政府性融资担保)
products.provider: Local guarantee agencies and the National Financing Guarantee Fund, with partner banks
products.indicative_rate_text: Guarantee fee targeted at 1% a year or less; the fund reported an average fee of 0.72% on its partner business by March 2025. The loan rate itself is set by the bank.
products.collateral: Guarantee agency may require counter-guarantees from the owner
documents_required: Loan application at the partner bank
unconfirmed: The 5 million yuan single-borrower figure is a policy quota or subsidy threshold, not a hard limit
Other cited pages: https://www.chinanews.com.cn/cj/2025/05-08/10412223.shtml
These pages were seen only in search summaries
Tenor not found

products.name: Short-term export credit insurance for small and micro exporters (Sinosure SME umbrella policy)
products.provider: China Export & Credit Insurance Corporation (Sinosure), Shenzhen branch
products.indicative_rate_text: Premium not found. Cover is for a one-year policy; free buyer credit reports were included in Shenzhen's 2022 scheme. This is insurance against buyer non-payment, not a loan; it can improve bank financing on receivables.
unconfirmed: Threshold is USD 6 million (Shantou policy for 2022) or USD 8 million (Shenzhen policy for 2024) of prior-year exports, depending on the local scheme and year; check the current Shenzhen notice
Premium rate and cover ratio not found
A seller on a marketplace is paid by the platform, so buyer risk is limited; relevance mostly applies to direct B2B sales

products.name: Cross-border seller inventory and logistics finance based on marketplace data
products.provider: Fintech lenders and partner banks (for example Currenxie, Dowsure with Bank of China Shenzhen)
products.indicative_rate_text: A promotional all-in cost 'as low as 3.99% a year' was reported for a Bank of China Shenzhen and Dowsure programme; treat as marketing, not confirmed.
products.collateral: Marketplace sales data and stock; terms not found
unconfirmed: The 2 million yuan per store and 3.99% figures came from a low-quality mirror site
The GTR page describes Currenxie (Hong Kong) offering inventory and logistics finance from Amazon trading history; no amounts or rates
12-month history requirement is an assumption

products.name: Growth Guarantee Scheme term loan (70% government guarantee to the lender)
products.provider: British Business Bank accredited lenders (banks and other lenders)
products.indicative_rate_text: Set by each lender and reflects the guarantee; no scheme-wide rate. The borrower stays 100% liable. Reported July 2026 changes: terms up to 10 years for loans up to GBP 1.1 million and a higher turnover limit.
products.collateral: Lender decides; personal guarantees may be asked; the owner's main home cannot be taken as security
documents_required: Latest management accounts and filed accounts
unconfirmed: British Business Bank scheme page was not reachable (404 or 403); details are from lender and broker pages
Turnover limit may have risen to GBP 54 million in July 2026 (https://www.simplybusiness.co.uk/knowledge/funding/growth-guarantee-scheme-updated-2026/)
Minimum tenor of 3 months is an assumption

Whether overdrafts, asset finance and invoice finance are covered was not confirmed in the pages read; Novuna offers a GGS asset-finance version (https://www.novuna.co.uk/business-finance/finance-products/growth-guarantee-scheme/)

products.name: Business overdraft
products.indicative_rate_text: One broker guide: about 11% to 35% EAR with set-up or renewal fees; another: roughly 13% to 17% EAR for overdrafts up to GBP 25,000 to 50,000.
products.collateral: Often unsecured for small limits; may need a personal guarantee
unconfirmed: Broker and comparison-site figures only; no bank page read
Limit of GBP 50,000 is described as typical, not a rule
12-month renewal cycle assumed

products.name: Asset finance (hire purchase or lease) for equipment
products.indicative_rate_text: Roughly 4% to 10% a year for established businesses entering 2026, depending on the asset and term (one guide).
unconfirmed: Tenor range and minimum trading history are typical assumptions
No lender page read

products.name: Invoice finance (factoring or discounting) on trade debtors
products.indicative_rate_text: Advance typically 70% to 90% of invoice value. Discount charge about SONIA plus 2.5% to 4.5% a year. Service fee commonly 0.8% to 1.8% of turnover (range 0.5% to 2.5%). Arrangement fee 0.5% to 1% of the limit. Minimum turnover about GBP 100,000 (some lenders from GBP 50,000).
unconfirmed: Broker figures only, no ABFA or British Business Bank data found
Contract length of 12 months is assumed
A 10% trade-debtor share is an assumption; a garden centre with 15% trade sales is a borderline fit

products.name: Revenue-based finance repaid from card sales (merchant cash advance)
products.provider: YouLend and similar providers, often through payment providers
products.indicative_rate_text: A single fixed fee agreed up front rather than interest; repayment is a percentage of daily card sales, so it rises and falls with takings. Quoted effective cost can be high; no UK standard percentage found.
products.collateral: None; repayments taken from card sales
unconfirmed: Amount range is from the provider's own UK page as reported by search summaries; the page was not opened directly
Minimum card sales history is an assumption
Regulatory status not checked against the FCA register
Approval-rate claims are the company's own

products.name: Unsecured business term loan from a bank or alternative lender
products.indicative_rate_text: Indicative index: about 10% to 18% APR for prime borrowers with 3+ years trading and about 18% to 30% for standard borrowers with 2+ years trading; high-street representative rates were quoted at about 9.9% to 15.7% APR in another guide.
unconfirmed: Broker rate index, not a lender quote
Tenor range assumed
Bank of England Bank Rate quoted as 3.75% in early 2026 by one guide; not verified

products.name: HMRC Time to Pay payment plan for a tax bill the business cannot pay in full
products.indicative_rate_text: Not a loan. HMRC checks affordability and sets instalments. Interest on late tax may apply; the rate and length were not confirmed.
documents_required: Income and spending details to show affordability
unconfirmed: The gov.uk overview page only says a payment plan may be possible and that HMRC checks affordability; eligibility rules, whether VAT is included, interest and duration were not on the page read
The Time to Pay page URL returned 404
